name: 双变量关系图
description: 选择两个字段后自动生成 300 DPI 散点趋势图、分组箱线图或列联热力图，并输出关系强度报告与原数据。
masterEvidence: 按字段类型自动选择关系图
输出 300 DPI 图片和统计关系报告
code:
# E4 双变量关系图：根据字段类型自动选择散点图、箱线图或列联热力图
import io
import base64
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'],
    'axes.unicode_minus': False,
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 15,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
})

NAVY = '#1F3A93'
ORANGE = '#E69F00'
GRID = '#E0E0E0'
x_column = {{x}}
y_column = {{y}}
group_column = {{group}}
show_trendline = bool({{trendline}})


def _to_frame(value):
    if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):
        return value.copy()
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        for encoding in ('utf-8-sig', 'utf-8', 'gbk', 'gb18030'):
            try:
                return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.decode(encoding)))
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                continue
        raise RuntimeError('CSV 编码无法识别')
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.lstrip('\ufeff')))
    raise RuntimeError('输入 data 必须是 CSV 文本或 DataFrame')


def _style(ax, grid_axis='both'):
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#999999')
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#999999')
    ax.grid(axis=grid_axis, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, color=GRID, alpha=0.5)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)


if data is None:
    raise RuntimeError('请先连接并运行上游的数据导入插件')
df = _to_frame(data)
if not x_column or not y_column:
    raise RuntimeError('请选择 X 字段和 Y 字段')
for column in [x_column, y_column]:
    if column not in df.columns:
        raise RuntimeError('找不到字段：' + str(column))
if group_column is not None and group_column != '' and group_column not in df.columns:
    raise RuntimeError('找不到分组字段：' + str(group_column))
if group_column not in (None, '') and df[group_column].nunique(dropna=True) > 12:
    raise RuntimeError('分组字段类别超过 12 个，图例会过于拥挤；请先合并稀有类别')

x_numeric = pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[x_column])
y_numeric = pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[y_column])
if x_numeric != y_numeric:
    _category_column = y_column if x_numeric else x_column
    if df[_category_column].nunique(dropna=True) > 30:
        raise RuntimeError('类别数量超过 30 个，图表会过于拥挤；请先合并稀有类别')
elif not x_numeric and not y_numeric:
    if df[x_column].nunique(dropna=True) > 30 or df[y_column].nunique(dropna=True) > 30:
        raise RuntimeError('类别数量超过 30 个，列联热力图会过于拥挤；请先合并稀有类别')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.2, 5.7), facecolor='white')
report = {'x': str(x_column), 'y': str(y_column), 'group': None if group_column in (None, '') else str(group_column)}
layout_left = 0.11
layout_right = 0.96
layout_bottom = 0.17

if x_numeric and y_numeric:
    plot_columns = [x_column, y_column] + ([] if group_column in (None, '') else [group_column])
    plot_data = df[plot_columns].dropna(subset=[x_column, y_column])
    if len(plot_data) < 2:
        raise RuntimeError('两个字段的有效配对数据不足 2 行')
    if group_column not in (None, ''):
        sns.scatterplot(data=plot_data, x=x_column, y=y_column, hue=group_column, palette='colorblind', s=46, alpha=0.78, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.35, ax=ax)
    else:
        sns.scatterplot(data=plot_data, x=x_column, y=y_column, color=NAVY, s=46, alpha=0.78, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.35, ax=ax)
    correlation = float(plot_data[[x_column, y_column]].corr(method='pearson').iloc[0, 1])
    slope = None
    intercept = None
    r_squared = None
    if show_trendline and plot_data[x_column].nunique() >= 2:
        slope, intercept = np.polyfit(plot_data[x_column].astype(float), plot_data[y_column].astype(float), 1)
        x_line = np.linspace(float(plot_data[x_column].min()), float(plot_data[x_column].max()), 100)
        y_line = slope * x_line + intercept
        ax.plot(x_line, y_line, color=ORANGE, linewidth=2.0, label='线性趋势')
        predicted = slope * plot_data[x_column].astype(float) + intercept
        ss_res = float(((plot_data[y_column].astype(float) - predicted) ** 2).sum())
        ss_tot = float(((plot_data[y_column].astype(float) - plot_data[y_column].astype(float).mean()) ** 2).sum())
        r_squared = 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot if ss_tot else 0.0
        ax.legend(frameon=False)
    ax.text(0.02, 0.97, f'n = {len(plot_data):,}\nPearson r = {correlation:.3f}' + ('' if r_squared is None else f'\nR² = {r_squared:.3f}'), transform=ax.transAxes, ha='left', va='top', fontsize=9.5, bbox={'boxstyle': 'round,pad=0.42', 'facecolor': 'white', 'edgecolor': '#D5DEEA', 'alpha': 0.94})
    report.update({
        'relationship_type': 'numeric_numeric',
        'valid_pairs': int(len(plot_data)),
        'pearson_correlation': correlation,
        'slope': None if slope is None else float(slope),
        'intercept': None if intercept is None else float(intercept),
        'r_squared': None if r_squared is None else float(r_squared),
    })
    longest_field = max(len(str(x_column)), len(str(y_column)))
    fig.set_size_inches(min(15.0, 9.2 + max(0, longest_field - 10) * 0.14), 6.2)
    if group_column not in (None, ''):
        handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
        ax.legend(handles, labels, frameon=False, loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1.0), borderaxespad=0)
        layout_right = 0.78
    _style(ax, 'both')
elif x_numeric != y_numeric:
    category_column = y_column if x_numeric else x_column
    numeric_column = x_column if x_numeric else y_column
    plot_data = df[[category_column, numeric_column]].dropna()
    if plot_data[category_column].nunique() > 30:
        plt.close(fig)
        raise RuntimeError('类别数量超过 30 个，图表会过于拥挤；请先合并稀有类别')
    if len(plot_data) < 2:
        plt.close(fig)
        raise RuntimeError('两个字段的有效配对数据不足 2 行')
    category_count = int(plot_data[category_column].nunique())
    fig.set_size_inches(max(9.2, min(18.0, 7.0 + category_count * 0.36)), 8.0 if category_count > 12 else 6.2)
    order = plot_data.groupby(category_column, observed=True)[numeric_column].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index.tolist()
    sns.boxplot(data=plot_data, x=category_column, y=numeric_column, order=order, color='#A8C5E5', width=0.58, linewidth=1.0, fliersize=4, ax=ax)
    sns.stripplot(data=plot_data, x=category_column, y=numeric_column, order=order, color=NAVY, size=3.8, alpha=0.55, jitter=0.16, ax=ax)
    group_summary = {}
    for key, series in plot_data.groupby(category_column, observed=True)[numeric_column]:
        group_summary[str(key)] = {
            'count': int(series.count()),
            'mean': float(series.mean()),
            'median': float(series.median()),
            'std': float(series.std(ddof=1)) if series.count() > 1 else 0.0,
        }
    report.update({
        'relationship_type': 'categorical_numeric',
        'categorical_field': str(category_column),
        'numeric_field': str(numeric_column),
        'valid_pairs': int(len(plot_data)),
        'group_summary': group_summary,
    })
    ax.set_title(f'{numeric_column} 在不同 {category_column} 组别中的分布', loc='left', fontweight='bold', pad=14)
    ax.set_xlabel(str(category_column))
    ax.set_ylabel(str(numeric_column))
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=90 if category_count > 12 else 30, labelsize=7.5 if category_count > 12 else 9)
    layout_bottom = 0.31 if category_count > 12 else 0.18
    _style(ax, 'y')
else:
    plot_data = df[[x_column, y_column]].dropna()
    if plot_data[x_column].nunique() > 30 or plot_data[y_column].nunique() > 30:
        plt.close(fig)
        raise RuntimeError('类别数量超过 30 个，列联热力图会过于拥挤；请先合并稀有类别')
    if len(plot_data) < 2:
        plt.close(fig)
        raise RuntimeError('两个字段的有效配对数据不足 2 行')
    contingency = pd.crosstab(plot_data[x_column], plot_data[y_column])
    category_count = max(int(contingency.shape[0]), int(contingency.shape[1]))
    matrix_size = max(9.2, min(18.0, 5.0 + category_count * 0.43))
    fig.set_size_inches(matrix_size, matrix_size * 0.84)
    sns.heatmap(contingency, cmap='Blues', annot=True, fmt='d', linewidths=0.7, linecolor='white', cbar_kws={'label': '样本数'}, ax=ax)
    report.update({
        'relationship_type': 'categorical_categorical',
        'valid_pairs': int(len(plot_data)),
        'contingency_table': {
            str(row): {str(column): int(contingency.loc[row, column]) for column in contingency.columns}
            for row in contingency.index
        },
    })
    ax.set_title(f'{x_column} 与 {y_column} 的列联分布', loc='left', fontweight='bold', pad=14)
    ax.set_xlabel(str(y_column))
    ax.set_ylabel(str(x_column))
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=90 if category_count > 12 else 30, labelsize=7 if category_count > 12 else 9)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0, labelsize=7 if category_count > 12 else 9)
    if category_count > 12:
        longest_y = max([len(str(value)) for value in contingency.index] + [0])
        layout_left = min(0.30, 0.11 + max(0, longest_y - 10) * 0.007)
        layout_bottom = 0.29

if x_numeric and y_numeric:
    ax.set_title(f'{x_column} 与 {y_column} 的关系', loc='left', fontweight='bold', pad=14)
    ax.set_xlabel(str(x_column))
    ax.set_ylabel(str(y_column))
ax.tick_params(axis='x', pad=7)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', pad=7)
fig.text(0.08, 0.025, '注：趋势线仅用于描述变量间的线性关系，不代表因果关系。', fontsize=8.5, color='#666666')
fig.subplots_adjust(left=layout_left, right=layout_right, top=0.89, bottom=layout_bottom)
_buffer = io.BytesIO()
fig.savefig(_buffer, format='png', dpi=300, facecolor='white', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
image = 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(_buffer.getvalue()).decode('ascii')
return {'image': image, 'report': report, 'data': data}
